# SoundTouch

Unmodified SoundTouch sources from PCSX2 v2.1.27, revision
`dcfd663c1903025864a865d3fcf508d0caab70c7`, used for stereo music time stretching.
`source-files.json` records each upstream path and SHA-256. The runtime builds
its tempo and rate processing components; beat detection is not used.
